scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run config:build && wrangler dev --port 8787 --local -c wrangler.build.toml
scripts.deploy: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run build && npm run config:build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.build.toml
scripts.migrate:local: npm run config:build && wrangler d1 migrations apply worker-desk --local -c wrangler.build.toml
scripts.migrate:remote: npm run config:build && wrangler d1 migrations apply worker-desk --remote -c wrangler.build.toml
